Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Is there any options to use the additional bleed action provided by the combat version of Taking the skin : minion during another methuselah's turn ?

Innocuous example, The Ankou with abombwe burns a vampire who just hunted, then plays taking the skin and untaps. Can he bleed now ?

I know it sounds twisted, but the card text clearly says I can bleed *this* turn. Even if does not mention other methuselah, semantically it sounds ok to act the turn Taking the skin is played. Sounds like a nice discovery, but i'll let you crush my dream with funky explanations

Taking the Skin: Minion
Action Modifier
Combat

Abombwe

Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
Skin. Play when this vampire burns a minion. Put this card on this vampire and untap him or her. This vampire may bleed an additional time this turn and gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when bleeding. Burn this card during your discard phase. A minion can have only one skin.

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
> johannes wrote:
> Also a (maybe stupid?) question: if I diablerize and then play "taking the skin" I can bleed twice with the minion, each time with +1/+1 right? (provided I have a freak drive or similiar to untap in between)
>
No, it's not a stupid question : The card text of taking the skin minion will allow you to bleed twice.
It supercedes the rules.
-and most abombwe players use it this way : Bleed, being blocked, blocker is vaporised, untap with Taking the skin, then bleed again with an additional bleed and stealth. But you can also burn a vampire from your prey in torpor (and play predator's transformation for 2 pool damage), play taking the skin, bleed for 2, freak drive, bleed again for 2.

I often say Abombwe is a totally overlooked discipline.

> Izaak wrote:
>
> > @Reyda : as I read the card, the card does not explicitely allow you to ignore more restriction than the NRA rule. So you can't use it on another player turn.
> >
> Ye that seems the logical answer, and the ne I'd give as well, but the card text is kinda ambigious here.
>
That's why I'm asking  The rule is : card text takes precedence. Taking the skin already allows me to perform an action i'm not supposed to do again. As it is written the text could allow me to do this action even if it's not my turn. maybe it's not just semantics ?

I'm waiting for Floppy's answer.

> Reyda wrote:
> That's why I'm asking  The rule is : card text takes precedence. Taking the skin already allows me to perform an action i'm not supposed to do again. As it is written the text could allow me to do this action even if it's not my turn. maybe it's not just semantics ?

The point you deliberaty ignore is that card supersede rule only when they explicitely supersede rules. It's not apparently the case here, since the only rule explicitely stated is the number of time you can bleed per turn. You can bleed the same number of time on your turn than on other people turn, provided you can act at all.

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
That's way too many moving parts. There's like, no way that will ever actually work, especially since the better alternative is just kill other people's stuff instead.

A guy in our group had a deck with Taking the Skin with just Matata and friends. It's fairly simple to burn vampires with ani/abo so what he just did was burn weenies and allies backwards or crosstable and bleed forward. It worked kinda ok, because you get to bleed for a surprisingly high amount considering how many combat cards you actually play.

It took some very careful play to decide what you needed to burn without giving away the table to someone else and it was kinda dull to play against but it did work quite well.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Reyda wrote:
> Is there any options to use the additional bleed action provided by the combat version of Taking the skin : minion during another methuselah's turn ?
>
Not without anything explicitly allowing it.

> Reyda wrote:
> Innocuous example, The Ankou with abombwe burns a vampire who just hunted, then plays taking the skin and untaps. Can he bleed now ?
>
Not unless the Madness Network is in play.

> Reyda wrote:
> I know it sounds twisted, but the card text clearly says I can bleed *this* turn. Even if does not mention other methuselah, semantically it sounds ok to act the turn Taking the skin is played. Sounds like a nice discovery, but i'll let you crush my dream with funky explanations
>
It reads you may bleed this turn indeed. However, Powerbase: Montreal reads "Any vampire may steal this location for his or her controller as a  action." , which doesn't allow out-of-turn actions.
